body:

is involved in CENP-A containing chromatin asselmby.

GO:0034080 | CENP-A containing chromatin assembly | IMP | Hayashi T et al. (2004) | 21

This happens in interphase and chromosome segregation in M-phase, so 

GO:0007059 | chromosome segregation | IBA with MGI:1913828 , PTN001046424 | GO_REF:0000033 | 157

seems quite indirect (readout, obviously if CENP-A chromatin is incorrect the kinetochore cannot assembly correctly and causes chromosome segregation defects)
